title: Category deny list
description: Prohibited categories per jurisdiction. A want or a have whose category matches a denied glob for the poster's jurisdiction is rejected with CATEGORY_PROHIBITED, unless the entry's mode is 'screening', in which case its reason code is enforced on the posting's content at screening time instead. Entries with status 'vertical-policy-pending' mark grey zones the operator has not yet opened rather than hard prohibitions.

jurisdiction.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, or '*' for all jurisdictions.

mode.description: How the entry is enforced. 'deny' (the default): a want or a have whose category matches is refused at publish time with CATEGORY_PROHIBITED. 'screening': the category is NOT refused; the reason code is checked against the posting's content at screening time, and a posting that carries it is refused as SCREENING_REJECTED. Use 'screening' for a reason that describes some postings in a category rather than the category itself, such as stolen-goods markers across all goods.
